The '''GAR clone barracks''' were created for the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion's]] [[Torrent Company/Legends|Torrent Company]] had designated living quarters at the barracks.
